race.description: 2026 Ladbrokes Sunshine Stars Yearling Sale Classic Heat 1 - 2yo Fillies
race.comment: WALK WITH ELEGANCE (2) ran fourth last start at this track over 1660m, beaten 16 metres. Talented and has plenty of upside. No excuses from this advantageous draw. Needs to be at her best to beat this field but she is up to the challenge. FAN THE FLAME (5) ran fifth last start at this track over 1660m, beaten 17 metres. Talented and has plenty of upside. Capable of playing a major role so has to be respected. CRUNCHY TUNA (3) is better than her last-start seventh over 1660m at this track would suggest. Won here three runs back and is worth another chance. MILA (7) broke in the run and finished fifth, beaten 9 metres when on debut last time out over 1780m at Redcliffe. Tactics will be crucial from this wide draw. It doesn't get any easier but she is talented enough to be competitive. Include in combinations.
